groups.definition: Risk that acquisition-related goodwill or intangible assets become impaired, causing significant non-cash charges to earnings.
Risk that intensifying domestic competition in foreign markets such as China erodes joint venture results, leading to impairments, equity losses and restructuring charges.
Risk that low-cost manufacturers from countries such as China and India take market share and pressure pricing.
Risk that restructuring or footprint changes require significant costs, capex or impairments and may fail to deliver expected benefits.
